in_hebrew.name: ביתינה
in_hebrew.long_meaning: The Hebrew name Bethina means 'house of God'. It is a variation of Bethany, which is also derived from the Hebrew word 'beth' meaning 'house' and 'any' meaning 'God'.

in_greek.name: Βηθεινή
in_greek.long_meaning: The Greek name Bethina is transliterated from the Hebrew name Bethina, which means 'house of God'. The Greek name Bētheinē is derived from the Hebrew 'beth' meaning 'house' and 'any' meaning 'God'.

in_latin.name: Bethina
in_latin.long_meaning: The Latin name Bethina is a transliteration of the Greek name Bētheinē, which means 'house of God'. The Latin name Bethina is also a variation of the Latin name Bethania, which is derived from the Hebrew 'beth' meaning 'house' and 'ania' meaning 'God's grace' or 'mercy'.
